# Achievements

<!-- Generated from the engine code by `make docs`: do not edit by hand. -->

Feats kept in the profile from one game to the next, with the collection:
every joker, deck, consumable, pull request, badge, boss, package, modifier
and hand type, found once obtained in a game (a joker bought, a badge won, a
boss beaten…). Some achievements unlock a hidden item, which games never
offer before. A game where a cheat was used still fills the collection, but
counts for no achievement.

| Id | Achievement | Condition | Unlocks | Quip |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `hello_world` | Hello, World | Win a blind |  | *Every journey starts with a printf.* |
| `its_not_a_phase` | It's Not a Phase | Win a game | RAID 1 (deck) | *Yes, mom, I use Arch now.* |
| `duplicate_detected` | Duplicate Detected | Play a Fork Bomb: five identical cards | Hash Collision (joker) | *Same card, five times. Totally legit.* |
| `core_dump` | Core Dump | Lose 5 games | Postmortem (joker) | *Something went wrong. Five times.* |
| `one_liner` | One-Liner | Beat a boss blind in one hand, without discarding |  | *Could have been a shell script.* |
| `big_o` | Big O | Score 1,000,000 in one hand |  | *O(1) mult. O(n!) chips.* |
| `heat_death` | Heat Death | Score 100,000,000 in one hand | Integer Overflow (joker) | *The universe ends. Your score doesn't.* |
| `bare_metal` | Bare Metal | Win a game without ever holding more than 2 jokers | Single Binary (joker) | *No VMs. No containers. No jokers.* |
| `savings_account` | Savings Account | Have $200 at once |  | *Cloud exit savings, finally visible.* |

| `sunk_cost` | Sunk Cost | Reroll 10 times in one shop |  | *One more reroll. Just one.* |
| `long_term_support` | Long-Term Support | Reach ante 12 |  | *Rolling release, rolling ante.* |
| `rtfm` | RTFM | Open the collection |  | *You actually read the manual.* |
| `collector` | Collector | Find 100 things for the collection |  | *Gotta pacman -S them all.* |
| `nothing_left_to_install` | Nothing Left to Install | Find everything in the collection |  | *Nothing left to install.* |
